comment:
* CarrierPrivilegesTracker will track the Carrier Privileges for a specific {@link Phone}.
 * Registered Telephony entities will receive notifications when the UIDs with these privileges
 * change.

variables.name: CLEAR_UICC_RULES_DELAY_MILLIS
variables.comment:
* Time delay to clear UICC rules after UICC is gone.
     * This introduces the grace period to retain carrier privileges when SIM is removed.
     *
     * This feature is off by default due to the security concern during inter-carriers switching.

variables.name: INSTALLED_PACKAGES_QUERY_FLAGS
variables.comment:
* PackageManager flags used to query installed packages.
     * Include DISABLED_UNTIL_USED components. This facilitates cases where a carrier app
     * is disabled by default, and some other component wants to enable it when it has
     * gained carrier privileges (as an indication that a matching SIM has been inserted).

variables.name: ACTION_SIM_STATE_UPDATED
variables.comment:
* Action for tracking when the Phone's SIM state changes.
     * arg1: slotId that this Action applies to
     * arg2: simState reported by this Broadcast

variables.name: ACTION_PACKAGE_ADDED_REPLACED_OR_CHANGED
variables.comment:
* Action for tracking when a package is installed, replaced or changed (exclude the case
     * disabled by user) on the device.
     * obj: String package name that was installed, replaced or changed on the device.

variables.name: ACTION_PACKAGE_REMOVED_OR_DISABLED_BY_USER
variables.comment:
* Action for tracking when a package is uninstalled or disabled by user on the device.
     * obj: String package name that was installed or disabled by user on the device.

variables.name: ACTION_INITIALIZE_TRACKER
variables.comment: * Action used to initialize the state of the Tracker.

variables.name: ACTION_SET_TEST_OVERRIDE_RULE
variables.comment:
* Action to set the test override rule through {@link TelephonyManager#setCarrierTestOverride}.
     * obj: String of the carrierPrivilegeRules from method setCarrierTestOverride.

variables.name: ACTION_CLEAR_UICC_RULES
variables.comment: * Action to clear UICC rules.

variables.name: ACTION_UICC_ACCESS_RULES_LOADED
variables.comment: * Action to handle the case when UiccAccessRules has been loaded.

variables.name: ACTION_SET_TEST_OVERRIDE_CARRIER_SERVICE_PACKAGE
variables.comment:
* Action to set the test override rule through {@link * TelephonyManager#setCarrierServicePackageOverride}. * *

obj: String of the carrierServicePackage from method setCarrierServicePackageOverride.

variables.name: mCarrierConfigRules
variables.comment: Stores rules for Carrier Config-loaded rules

variables.name: mUiccRules
variables.comment: Stores rules for SIM-loaded rules.

variables.name: mTestOverrideRules
variables.comment: - Non-empty list indicates test override with specific rules (CC and UICC rules are ignored)

variables.name: mInstalledPackageCerts
variables.comment: Map of PackageName -> Certificate hashes for that Package

variables.name: mCachedUids
variables.comment: Map of PackageName -> UIDs for that Package

variables.name: mPrivilegedPackageInfoLock
variables.comment: with the mPrivilegedPackageInfoLock object itself.

variables.name: mPrivilegedPackageInfo
variables.comment: Package names and UIDs of apps that currently hold carrier privileges.

variables.name: mClearUiccRulesUptimeMillis
variables.comment: Uptime in millis on when the NEXT clear-up of UiccRules are scheduled

variables.name: CLEAR_UICC_RULE_NOT_SCHEDULED
variables.comment: Constant indicates no schedule to clear UiccRules

variables.name: mSimIsReadyButNotLoaded
variables.comment: SIM becomes LOADED again, or grace period specified by CLEAR_UICC_RULES_DELAY_MILLIS expires.
